resolved_findings.summary: Injected empty bundle fake bypasses original production constructor coverage
resolved_findings.reason: The old durable integration used NewService default builder, whose Tasks != nil branch excludes legacy session WorkingStore. Supplying memoryPolicyBundles bypasses that branch and returns empty Working unconditionally. The stale-session snapshot assertions therefore no longer exercise that production construction path.
resolved_findings.requested_change: Wrap the actual service.config.MemoryBundles after NewService with a capturing delegate, retaining its real BuildBundle result. Assert legacyWorking.getCalls stays empty, alongside existing no saves/clears and task A-to-B context assertions.
resolved_findings.resolution: capturedTaskBundles wraps the actual service.config.MemoryBundles only after NewService has constructed it and delegates ctx/request/result unchanged. Both initial service and restart use the wrapper. The test now asserts no legacyWorking reads, in addition to no saves/clears and task A-to-B goal capture.
